messages:
sam_infra: FYI scheduling a short window for US-east1 tonight 02:00-04:00 UTC. Scope: NIC microcode on two racks (c1,c2) + emergency ARP table flush experiment. Plan: cordon -> graceful drain -> flash -> reboot -> kv-warm.
maya_sre: Expected impact on hosted capacity? any dedicated racks?
sam_infra: No dedicated tenants on c1/c2. Transient capacity drop ~9-13% per rack for ~10-20m each. We'll enable cross-region fallback to us-west during the drain.
dan_ops: I'll push preemptible backfill 12m prior. Command: ./ops backfill --to us-west1 --label preemptible --until 02:20. I'll run dry-run now.
ryan_net: ARP flush experiment: on canary host we'll run arp -d -a then monitor grpc/connect errors. If tcp retransmits >1% or grpc errors >0.4% abort.
ops-bot: Maintenance ticket INC-US-1755 created. Reminder set 30m before.
dan_ops: Dry-run: backfill would move 28 jobs, freeing 5 gpus in us-east. Cost delta est ~$75 for the extra us-west usage.
sam_infra: Canary plan: take 1 node in c1, cordon, reboot, run synthetic queries to top-4 models + embed; pass if p95 delta <60ms and errors <0.3%. Also run arp flush on canary only.
maya_sre: I'll flip routing policy 'us-east-arp-fallback' at start and monitor failover traces.
ops-bot: Canary-check failed: after arp flush on c1-canary p95 +110ms on 'small-v1' model. @sam_infra @ryan_net please investigate.
ryan_net: Looking at switch ARP snooping counters; the canary lost neighbor entries and the host ARP cache repop is slow. Rolling back ARP flush on canary now and rejoin.
dan_ops: Undoing cordon for remaining c1 nodes to restore capacity. Backfill returned 5 gpus.
sam_infra: Pause maintenance. We'll rollback routing flip and pause 40m to investigate ARP repop behavior. Maya, please update status page and execs.
status-bot: Posted incident update: INC-US-1755 paused after canary ARP-induced latency spike; engineers investigating.
maya_sre: Notifying execs and adding a preflight ARP repop check to playbook. Tentative resume 03:10 UTC after 40m soak.
